text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for IR-2026-03. We need owners & Jira links for the remediation items. I added a RACI in the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.com/pm/IR-2026-03-remediation. Please claim or delegate.

devon: I'll take "KV cache eviction safeguard". Will create a ticket.

sam: Assign me the "autoscale fallback policy" item.

lia: I'll own the "runbook + playbook" and the customer comms template.

maya: Thanks. Can everyone post the Jira ticket here. Prefer INF-... format so oncall-bot can pick them up.

devon: Created https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5542 -> INF-5542. ETA: 2026-04-01. I'll put a link to the test plan in the ticket.

sam: Ticket created INF-5543 - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5543. ETA: 2026-03-29. @devon can we sync on any overlapping work?

devon: Yup, let's pair tomorrow. Also tagging @lia for runbook changes that touch the autoscale docs.

lia: ACK. Created INF-5544 for runbook + comms -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5544. I'll loop in tech-comm.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: check INF-5542, INF-5543, INF-5544 on 2026-04-05. Reaction :bell:

maya: RACI summary (quick):

- Responsible: devon (INF-5542), sam (INF-5543), lia (INF-5544)
- Accountable: maya
- Consulted: eng-sre, eng-runtime
- Informed: product, support

maya: Next steps: owners add acceptance criteria + estimated effort to their Jira by EOD Tue. I'll collect and open a parent epic if scope justifies it.

sam: Added ACs to INF-5543. Estimate 6d.

devon: Added ACs + plan to INF-5542. Estimate 5d. Marking any risky steps as blocked until testing infra is ready.

lia: Added comms draft to INF-5544 and tagged @tech-comm. Estimate 2d.

maya: Great. I'll create a weekly follow-up thread and assign remediation status checkpoint every Wednesday. If anything slips, ping me and we'll escalate.

jira-bot: Parent epic created INF-5600 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5600 (IR-2026-03 remediations). Linked INF-5542, INF-5543, INF-5544.

sam: noted, thx :thumbsup: 

maya: Closing the loop here. Handoff note: if any owner will be OOO during work, add a backup owner in the ticket. Also set a reviewer for prod rollout.

devon: Will add @natalie as backup for rollout testing.

lia: I'll add @mike as comms reviewer.

maya: Perfect. We'll reconvene in the weekly remediation sync. Thanks all. :heart:
